label: Late copy-phase steps (recalling original token 6 or later)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.9% of mass), and only when the model is outputting a late original position: recall_idx 0-4 is nearly silent, recall_idx 5 is weak (15% rate), and recall_idx 6-8 fires on about half of steps (rate 0.47-0.52). Mass is concentrated near the end of the sequence (to_go 0 carries 62% of mass), so it shows up in long sequences (L 7-9). It is silent in the original phase and at the delimiter. Within eligible late steps, firing is only about 50% and depends weakly and diffusely on token identity (out_tok t/e/g/q/j up to about 4x lift, prev_tok g about 3x; the top examples often have g just before). No simple token rule captured this, so precision is incomplete. The broader predicate recall_idx >= 5 gives 0.98 mass recall at 0.35 precision. Highest-activation steps come at recall_idx 6-8 near the final output.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: g, w, l, e, 3, b; least: d, i, f, <DEL>) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: t, e, j, q; input phase: ; delimiter step: ); timing cues that raise it most: L=4 & t=7, to_go=0, recall_idx=6.
